title: Slugify titles with a pipeline of small Functions

blocks.text: A data-cleaning pipeline is a chain of small, named `Function<String, String>` steps joined with `andThen`; each step can be tested alone and the whole thing can be handed to `Stream.map`.

Write `Slugs.slugifier()`. It returns a `Function<String, String>` that turns a title into a URL slug, built from these steps: lower-case the text, remove every character that is not `a-z`, `0-9`, whitespace or `-`, trim, turn each run of whitespace into one space, and replace each space with `-`. Choose an order that gives the answers below.

Look closely at a title like `"Hello, World !"`. A `null` title has no slug: return `""`. Lower-casing is `toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)`, and the kept characters are exactly the ASCII letters `a-z` and digits `0-9` (plus whitespace and `-` before the last steps): `é` and `_` are removed. Hyphens already in a title are kept as they are; the tests use no title with a hyphen next to whitespace or at either end.

cases.says: Titles become lower-case, hyphen-joined slugs without punctuation.
Several spaces in a row become a single hyphen.
Punctuation beside a space leaves no hyphen at either end.
A null title gives an empty slug instead of a NullPointerException.
Accented letters and underscores are not a-z or 0-9, so they are removed.

concepts: Small named steps joined with andThen make a pipeline that is easy to read, test and reorder.
